coreMemory.english: v. to speak with someone and exchange ideas or information；v. to discuss a particular subject；v. to persuade someone to do or not do something
coreMemory.structure: talk to someone /ˈtɔːk ˈtuː ˈsʌˌmwʌn/（与某人交谈）；talk about something /ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（谈论某事）；talk someone into doing something /ˈtɔːk ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈɪntuː ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（说服某人做某事）；talk someone out of doing something /ˈtɔːk ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈaʊt ˈʌv ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（劝某人不要做某事）

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ talk someone doing something → ✅ talk someone into doing something；❌ talk someone out doing something → ✅ talk someone out of doing something

synonyms.difference: speak 侧重“说话；发言”。对应的常用英文义是 “to speak with someone or discuss a subject”。talk 在本卡搭配“talk to someone”中表达“交谈”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“交谈”这个义项下，listen（听；倾听）与 talk 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of talk”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

derivatives.note: 指具有某种谈话特点的人。

derivatives.chinese: 说话的；多嘴的；富有表情的
derivatives.note: talking 是 talk 的常用词族形式，作 n. 使用；对应的常用英文义是 “an exchange of ideas via conversation”。

confusables.difference: speak 表示“说；说话；演说”；talk 在本卡核心搭配“talk to someone”中表示“交谈”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
